answer: Each agent registers a Jade‑linked vault whose crystal‑signed transaction nonce must match the Zephyr‑derived time‑slot of the previous block; the network ties any new identity to the most recent vault hash, so a sybil must open a fresh vault, lock a stake equal to the average transaction fee (≈0.05 token) and wait one full epoch (≈10 minutes) for the Zephyr slot to become unique before its nonce is accepted. If the attacker creates N fakes, the total cost is N × (0.05 token + 10 minutes) locked, making large‑scale identity farming financially prohibitive.
